audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty is described around a non-existent 'W block' — K'Sante's Path Maker does not block projectiles.
audit.why: Path Maker (W) charges with damage reduction then dashes, knocking back and stunning; nothing in the kit blocks a projectile. The lane is hard because of the charge's damage reduction and the stun, not a block.
audit.corrected: Early lane is contested by Path Maker's charge soaking poke and its stun catching you; the lane slips at 6 to All Out.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two-item spike text credits K'Sante with a 'percent-HP passive'.
audit.why: Dauntless Instinct marks targets to take more damage on his next attack; it is not percent-health. The real two-item problem is stacked armour plus All Out's healing.
audit.corrected: Two items: armour stacking plus All Out healing beats lethality — Grievous Wounds is the answer, not more lethality.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'W block' and 'Q knock-up' are both wrong; the All Out true-damage interaction is missing.
audit.why: Ntofo Strikes (Q, 3.5s) slows and at two stacks fires a pull, not a knock-up — and that pull matters because Heroic Swing ends on champion collision. Path Maker (W, 14/13/12/11/10s) deals true damage, which no armour item answers.
audit.corrected: Two Ntofo stacks pull you, and champion collision knocks you off Heroic Swing; Path Maker's true damage ignores resistances; All Out (120/100/80s) launches you through a wall.

edits.before: Your second passive shot plus Heroic Swing come online — the one window to chip K'Sante with Q out-and-back before his W block and Q knock-up are leveled.
edits.after: Your second passive shot plus Heroic Swing come online — the one window to chip K'Sante with Q out-and-back before Path Maker (W) and the two-stack Ntofo pull are up.

edits.before: K'Sante's percent-HP passive and stacked armor blank your lethality while his empowered R brawl out-sustains your Comeuppance execute — he is functionally unkillable here.
edits.after: Stacked armour blanks your lethality and All Out's healing out-sustains your Comeuppance execute — buy Grievous Wounds before two items or he is functionally unkillable here.

edits.before: Bait his W (Ntofo block) empty with a fake Q, then commit Heroic Swing and the double-shot while it's down
edits.after: Fake a Q to burn Path Maker's charge, then commit Heroic Swing and the double-shot in its 14s downtime

edits.before: His W blocks your single Avengerang and his Q out-pokes your lone passive shot — concede level 1 and last-hit at range.
edits.after: Path Maker charge eats your Avengerang at reduced damage and Ntofo Strikes out-pokes your lone passive shot — last-hit at range.

edits.before: His W block and Q knock-up now answer your range — even trades only, hold E for the knock-up, never swing in.
edits.after: Path Maker's stun and the two-stack Ntofo pull answer your range — even trades, hold E for the stun, never swing in.

edits.before: His W still blocks your double-shot even after Youmuu's, so a botched all-in into an up W or R just gets you knocked out and killed.
edits.after: Path Maker's charge still soaks your double-shot even after Youmuu's, so an all-in into an up W or R gets you stunned out and killed.

edits.before: Level 1 he out-bullies you: his W blocks your single Avengerang and his Q out-pokes your lone passive shot, so just last-hit at max boomerang range. Your real window is levels 2-3 — once you have the second passive shot and Heroic Swing, chip him with Q out-and-back and double-shot trades, then disengage before he can answer. Do NOT throw a raw Q inside his W range; he blocks it and dashes onto you. Bait the W empty with a fake cast, then trade.
edits.after: Level 1 he out-bullies you: he charges Path Maker (W) to soak your single Avengerang at reduced damage and Ntofo Strikes out-pokes your lone passive shot, so last-hit at max boomerang range. Your real window is levels 2-3 — with the second passive shot and Heroic Swing, chip him with Q out-and-back and double-shot trades, then disengage before he answers. Do NOT throw a raw Q inside 600 range; he charges through it and dashes onto you. Bait W empty, then trade its 14s down.

edits.before: This is where it slips. His W block-and-dash eats your poke and erases the range your kit relies on, and his Q knock-up catches you mid Heroic Swing. Keep E as your escape from the knock-up, not your engage. At 6 his All Out is the nightmare — it isolates you, converts his W and Q into empowered fighter abilities, and knocks you back through terrain where your shieldless lethality body just dies. Never start Heroic Swing or channel Comeuppance near a wall while his R is up.
edits.after: This is where it slips. Path Maker charges through your poke at reduced damage then dashes in to stun, and two Ntofo Strikes fire a pull — champion collision ends Heroic Swing, so keep E as your escape from the stun, not your engage. At 6 All Out knocks you through a wall, dashes after you, and turns W into true damage no armour reads — your shieldless body just dies. Never open E or channel Comeuppance near a wall while his 80s R is up.

notes: K'Sante content repeatedly claimed Path Maker 'blocks' projectiles and that Q is a knock-up; both corrected. Dauntless Instinct is not a percent-HP passive.
